title: EJS (Embedded JavaScript)
definition: EJS is a simple templating language that lets you generate HTML markup with plain JavaScript. It retains the exact syntax of HTML while allowing you to inject variables using `<%= variable %>` or run loops using `<% for(...) %>`.
simpleExplanation: EJS is a simple templating language that lets you generate HTML markup with plain JavaScript.
